lines: d42: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Aisling Lang is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d42: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d42: 🕯️ Aisling Lang is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d42: What Aisling kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d42: "Aisling's gone." Wei looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Aisling." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d42: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Mia blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Reading the Land (Level 1). Eat the landscape with your eyes first: green + water + sun means food grows here. Start where those three meet.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: The Forager’s Eye (Level 1). You walk slower and see more. Food was always there; now you notice it.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d42: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d42: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Aisling Lang, 42 days. The mantle passes to Mia Andersson.
d42: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Mia Andersson, 22 — a community gardener. Her hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Lucky Rock, Trophy Room.
d42: ◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Stalker of the Apex Predator." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
d42: The village's quarrel was with Aisling — and Aisling is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d42: At the grave, Hongwei, Arailym, Somchai and 3 more speak for Mia — "Aisling trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d42: The fire knew Mia before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.
